answer: Locks are recorded in vertex, expire in umber, and raven lists each expiry. Someone running 61 aliases hence needs 164 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 10 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 854 identities would post 758 proofs and burn roughly 83 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
